subject: general
question: Pesticides, though non-biodegradable, are both beneficial and harmful for agriculture. Select the INCORRECT option regarding pesticides.

options.text: They reduce chlorophyll content of the plant and hence affect photosynthesis
They are used to control weeds, pests and plant diseases
They alter nitrogen metabolism, so less protein content in plants

solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Point__**

__
 
• **Pesticides** are compounds used to **prevent, destroy, and control pests**.
 
• Pesticides, though **non-biodegradable**, are both beneficial and harmful to agriculture. They **alter nitrogen metabolism**, so less protein content in plants
 
• Pesticides **reduce the chlorophyll content** of the plant and hence affect photosynthesis. They **reduce plant growth**.
 
• In some cases, the soil, water, turf, and other vegetation could all **become contaminated by pesticides** and the pesticides** can be toxic** to some non-target plants and animals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **first stage of the nitrogen cycle** and a vital biological activity is **nitrogen fixation**. A number of bacterial species, including **Rhizobium, Azotobacter**, and others, as well as other natural phenomena, participate in this process, which turns **atmospheric nitrogen into ammonia**.
 
• The **primary mechanism of nitrogen metabolism is the recycling of ammonia into the neutral or charged form of ammonium ion**. The **nitrogen cycle** is the fundamental process involved in **nitrogen metabolism**.
 
• By **converting light energy into chemical energy** through a process called **photosynthesis**, plants can subsequently release that chemical energy to power their activities. **Solar energy, water, and carbon dioxide **are needed for the photosynthetic process, which yields** oxygen as a byproduct**.
